_comment: Yield-per-cycle dials for time-based growth edges. These are REVIEWABLE KNOBS: mintscan treats each as a conversion edge with a gate on record. Counts are vanilla-median estimates (confidence field says how rough). A cycle that routes through a dial is gated by that dial — the report says so.

dials.name: bamboo-shoot-growth
dials.gate: hand/planned harvest; no vanilla auto-breaker in pack

dials.name: kelp-column
dials.gate: hand harvest, top replanted; water column required

dials.name: cactus-row
dials.gate: hand-break; no observer farm machinery in pack doctrine

dials.name: wheat-plot
dials.gate: farmland + water + hand harvest; seed return mean ~1.5 (0-3)
dials.notes: seed-return loop is the expanding edge; wheat is the byproduct

dials.name: melon-plot
dials.gate: farmland + water + hand harvest; slice->seed recipes carry the loop
dials.notes: seed loop completes via melon->slices->seed recipe edges

dials.name: pumpkin-plot
dials.notes: pumpkin -> 4 seeds crafting closes the loop

dials.name: sweet-berry-bush
dials.gate: hand harvest, bush persists and regrows

dials.name: chorus-flower
dials.gate: end islands only; hand harvest; flower spread bounded by plant age

dials.name: crimson-huge-fungus
dials.gate: hand chop; bonemeal cost not modeled (compound compost loop)
dials.notes: WOOD VECTOR — flagged in NEXT-UP open vectors

dials.name: warped-huge-fungus
dials.gate: hand chop; bonemeal cost not modeled (compound compost loop)
dials.notes: WOOD VECTOR — flagged in NEXT-UP open vectors

dials.name: oak-tree
dials.gate: growth time + hand chop; Dynamic Trees replaces mechanics post-install
dials.notes: wood economy dial — re-verify yield after DT lands

dials.name: birch-tree
dials.gate: growth time + hand chop; Dynamic Trees replaces mechanics post-install

_watch_compound: animal breeding (cow/sheep/pig/chicken): expanding, gated by farmland feed cost + hand work — compound loop, not modeled as a single edge
composter bonemeal: compound loop feeding fungus/tree dials — cost side not modeled
budding amethyst: shard growth is rate-limited and budding blocks are worldgen-fixed (not obtainable) — bounded, on watch
villager trading: code-constant corpus, not in fixture — rides a runtime probe (mintscan v2)
